title: UTV Tour Puerto Vallarta
overview: Explore the rainforest outside Puerto Vallarta on a thrilling UTV (Utility Terrain Vehicle) adventure. Get a brief safety tutorial and a lesson in driving the 4x4 Polaris RZR UTV. Then, throw on a helmet and goggles and hit the trails. Stop for a hike to a hidden natural pool where you can swim, relax beside a waterfall, and munch on light snacks included in the tour.
highlights: Go on a thrilling rainforest adventure in an UTV (utility terrain vehicle)
Escape the city and barrel through streams and down remote jungle paths
Learn how to maneuver a Polaris RZR UTV from an experienced instructor
Enjoy relaxing hike, a dip at a remote swim-hole, and complimentary snacks
startDescription: Hotel pickup is included from listed Puerto Vallarta hotels. Confirm the pickup window when booking.

title: Sierra Madre ATV Adventure from Puerto Vallarta
overview: Drive a single or 2-person all-terrain vehicle (ATV) through the Sierra Madre Mountains on a half-day adventure from Puerto Vallarta. You’ll splash through jungle rivers, pass quaint villages, and get a glimpse of the real Jalisco, far from crowded resorts. Morning and afternoon departures are available, with a small group size and included souvenir photos and safety gear: Drivers must have a valid license.
highlights: Roar through the Sierra Madre mountains on your own ATV
No extra charges for pictures: Souvenir shots are included
Small-group tour makes for a more intimate, personalized experience
Choice of departures let you plan your day and fit more in
inclusions: All taxes, fees and handling charges
startDescription: Meet at the confirmed Puerto Vallarta departure listed when booking. Hotel pickup is not included.

title: Puerto Vallarta Original Canopy Tour, Ziplining, Tequila and Speed Boat Ride
overview: Soar through the treetops of the rain forest straight into a tequila bar during this canopy tour, which begins with an optional speedboat ride. On Puerto Vallarta’s first-ever zipline circuit, cover two miles (three km) on strong cables suspended 328 feet (100 meters) in the air and enjoy panoramic vistas. Conclude the exhilarating experience with time to swim, kayak, and race down a waterslide, or greet the diverse wildlife of the on-site menagerie.
highlights: Puerto Vallarta jungle canopy zipline and speedboat ride tour
Soar over the river across 19 cables with distances up to 1,450 feet (442 meters) long
Purchase lunch and drinks at a riverside restaurant and taste tequila (included)
Swim and kayak plus observe marmosets, coatimundi, and boas at an animal sanctuary
inclusions: Land or Sea round trip transporation
Zip lines course with water stations
Kayaks, water slides and water activities on the river (weather permitting)
startDescription: Begin at the Los Veranos Canopy Tour main office or the confirmed speedboat departure listed when booking.

title: Mega Yacht ALL INCLUSIVE Yelapa Waterfall & Snorkeling Adventure
overview: This Yelapa Waterfalls and Snorkeling Yacht Cruise offers two different starting locations when booking, so you can find the place that’s most convenient for you to meet. This cruise features a fun day with all-inclusive, open-bar access, a fajita lunch, and activities such as kayaking and massages. Plus, the yacht has comfortable seating with shaded options available, too.
highlights: Cruise to Yelapa and Yelapa Waterfalls aboard a comfortable yacht
Get set up with the use of snorkeling equipment, kayaks, and paddleboards
Gain access to a premium onboard open bar for alcoholic drinks
Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are included so you don’t have to worry
inclusions: Use of Snorkel Equipment, Kayaks, Paddle Boards, water mattress,
startDescription: Check in at the Chica Locca Tours office at Puerto Mágico Cruise Ship Terminal, or the alternate meeting place chosen when booking.

title: Marietas Islands Snorkel Tour & Hidden Beach
overview: Discover the enchanting Marieta Islands on this snorkeling adventure from Puerto Vallarta. This tour has a 97% chance of visiting Hidden Beach—accessible only through a water tunnel—than other tours. Encounter diverse marine life including dolphins, turtles, and vibrant tropical fish, while underwater you can check out a colorful array of tropical fish.
highlights: Explore the Marieta Islands with a chance to see Hidden Beach
Discover a variety of marine life with provided snorkel gear
National park fees, snacks, and bottled water are provided
Private tours can be organized on request
inclusions: Conservancy donation fee to Bahia Unida
Snacks such as granola bars, apples, bananas and jelly sandwich.
startDescription: Meet at the confirmed Puerto Vallarta or Punta de Mita boat departure listed when booking.

title: Small-Group Half-Day Whale-Watching Tour in Puerto Vallarta
overview: Look for humpback whales in Banderas Bay on this half-day whale-watching tour from Puerto Vallarta. Learn about the majestic animals from your marine biologist guide as you ride on a small boat that is equipped with a restroom. Your tour includes lunch served on board the boat and accompanied by nonalcoholic beverages: Bring cash to pay the small port fee.
highlights: Half-day small-group whale-watching tour from Puerto Vallarta
Cruise the waters of Banderas Bay to spot migrating humpback whales
Learn about whale behavior from the marine biologist guide
Lunch and soft drinks keep hunger pangs at bay
startDescription: Hotel pickup is included from listed Puerto Vallarta hotels, or meet at the Marina Vallarta departure confirmed when booking.

title: hidden beach tour
overview: A small-group boat outing from Punta de Mita toward Hidden Beach in the Marietas Islands, with snorkeling gear, bottled water, lunch, and a swim through the water tunnel when park conditions allow.
highlights: Small-group Hidden Beach boat outing from Punta de Mita
Snorkel gear, bottled water, and lunch included
Swim through the water tunnel when park access allows
Maximum of 8 travelers
startDescription: Meet at Shark's Tour Punta de Mita, Av. Las Pangas 1, Corral del Risco, in front of the small marina.

title: Horseback Riding: Tequila Tasting, Mex BBQ & Margaritas
overview: Ride along the Mascota River on a guided horseback outing from Puerto Vallarta, then continue to La Dulce Vista for an artisanal tequila tasting and a traditional Mexican BBQ lunch with margaritas. Transport leaves from Marina Vallarta at Nima Bay.
highlights: Guided horseback ride along the Mascota River
Artisanal tequila tasting at La Dulce Vista
Traditional Mexican BBQ lunch with margaritas
Open-concept bus from Marina Vallarta
startDescription: Meet at Av Paseo de la Marina 121, Marina Vallarta, at the large mirror on the wall at the Nima Bay back car entrance across from V Marina. Arrive 5 minutes before the 10:30 a.m. departure.

title: Palo María Waterfalls Hike Half-Day Tour
overview: A guided half-day hike from Puerto Vallarta to the Palo María River and Cascadas Palo Maria in the Sierra Madre, with shared transport from Zona Romántica, bottled water, and snacks. The outing is limited to 10 travelers.
highlights: Guided hike to Palo María waterfalls
Shared transport from Zona Romántica
Bottled water and snacks included
Small group of up to 10 travelers
inclusions: Transportation shared with all tour attendants from meeting point to Palo María River.
startDescription: Meet at Parque Lázaro Cárdenas y Estacionamiento, at the corner of Lázaro Cárdenas and Pino Suárez in Zona Romántica.

title: Private Whale Watching Tour in Puerto Vallarta
overview: Take a private tour from Puerto Vallarta into Banderas Bay with a marine biologist. You will have the guide and the boat to yourself on this whale watching adventure. Depart from the marina and spend the morning spotting whales from a safe distance that won’t disturb them. Make sure you bring your your questions for the expert, and your camera to capture the moment.
highlights: Spend the morning on the well-equipped boat and enjoy lunch on the water
You will learn all about all sorts of marine wildlife, not just whales
Suitable for all ages; kids will love the individualized attention
This tour runs in the winter, when the humpback whales return to Vallarta
startDescription: Meet at Mr. Cream Pancakes & Waffles, Condominios Marina Sol Int. 3y4, Marina Vallarta, or use the included hotel pickup listed when booking.
